problem: The mini-window composer stacked a persistent multi-chip hotkey bar above the editor. Its flexible layout expanded vertically, obscured the conversation, and left API-key diagnostics dominating the actual input action.
solution: Replaced the stack with one adaptive ChatGPT-style composer: bounded auto-growing editor, compact lower toolbar, action menu, inline Local/Online/Offline state, white send button, native HUD blur, and a stronger black wash in compact mode. The hotkey reference moved to an on-demand sheet.
lesson: A compact composer should be one bounded action surface. Persistent shortcut education belongs behind progressive disclosure, while connectivity and provider state should remain concise and local to the toolbar.
